clips.title: The story
paras: The Call of Earth is an elemental trial undertaken by spiritual initiates to prove their steadfastness. By retrieving requested materials, the petitioner demonstrates their grit and determination to their instructor. Successfully enduring the task confirms their readiness to proceed to the next stage of their training.

The Call of Earth is a foundational trial for aspiring practitioners of the elements. Initiates are tasked with fulfilling specific demands to test their patience, resilience, and connection to the stubborn, enduring nature of the earth. Fulfilling the request demonstrates that an adventurer possesses the inner fortitude required to commune with primeval forces.

Upon returning with the requested offerings, the mentor recognizes the petitioner's unquestionable grit and determination. Having proven steadfast in the face of elemental demands, the initiate earns recognition and is deemed prepared to undertake the next step of their spiritual journey.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Al'Aketh cult represents the most direct and urgent danger to our homeland. Their increasingly extremist actions have destabilized our society and damaged our already-weakened connection to the spirits of the four winds. The elements demand action to prove our resilience and resolve, which are traits that are endemic to the domain of the element of earth.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have returned and brought what I have requested and thus your grit and determination are unquestionable. You are ready for the next step, friend.
